name: Site Search
description: A search box for your whole site. Visitors press ⌘K or click Search and find pages by title and text as they type. No outside service.

panels.title: Site search
panels.description: A search box that finds your published pages as visitors type. Every page can be found by its title straight away; its text is added the first time someone opens it. Members-only content is never searchable. Best for sites of up to a few hundred pages.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show a search box
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

choices.title: In the page header, beside the menu

fields.name: language
fields.title: Language
fields.description: For the words on the button and in the box.

fields.name: colour
fields.title: Colour
fields.description: For the selected result and the floating button.

fields.name: text-length
fields.title: Text searched per page (characters)
fields.description: More finds more, but makes every page a little heavier.

fields.name: skip-pages
fields.title: Leave these pages out
fields.description: Page addresses separated by commas, for example: 404, thanks, legal/*. A * at the end means every page under it.
